notes: J8 is part of each standard arm controller, not an extra tool-roll controller.
The assets are a disclosed R1Pro embodiment variant selected through the official --robot-config path and installed reproducibly under the canonical r1pro model key.
The evaluator and Interface must use this profile together because action and proprio dimensions differ from stock R1Pro.
Only the official RGB, depth, and standard R1Pro proprio fields are observed; assisted-grasp constraint truth is not requested.

Each finger receives an independent direct effort command. close_gripper seeks at 0.5N, ramps one independently blocked finger to 2N, then synchronously ramps bilateral contact from 1N to the 20N controller limit across the existing 12-frame stationary confirmation window and persists the 20N carry command.
Arm limits are J1/J2 110, J3/J4 50, J5-J7 36, and J8 20. Torso remains 1000 and controlled base x/y/yaw remains 10000.

The 250kg base velocity-drive damping is 30000/30000/1700 for x/y/yaw. Velocity and force limits are unchanged; x/y retain max-force acceleration at full command while all axes stay within the 120Hz monotone small-error bound, preventing two-phase chatter around a zero command.
The z, roll, and pitch virtual base joints retain their DOFs, have no DriveAPI because they are not mapped to a controller, and use asset-level 1e9 joint friction for permanent passive locking.
The evaluation wrapper performs no runtime joint-state reads or actuator mutations; all submitted effort changes are authored in static robot assets and controller configuration.

OmniGibson v3.9.1 performs an initial BehaviorTask reset before loading the challenge TRO and that scene metadata has only an r1pro-specific presampled pose, so this R1Pro variant must retain the canonical model key when the official evaluator source is left unchanged.
